title: Appeals.
bodyText: From the order made on an application for reconsideration or rehearing by the public utilities commission under this chapter, an appeal shall lie in the manner provided in section 269-15.5.
bodyHtml: [§269E-17]  Appeals.  From the order made on an application for reconsideration or rehearing by the public utilities commission under this chapter, an appeal shall lie in the manner provided in section 269-15.5. [L 2004, c 141, pt of §1, §7; am L 2009, c 72, §3]
